name: CBN Christian Broadcasting Network
desc:
Remote First Shift Contact Center Representative | $15.00/hr | Phone Heavy, Faith-Based Ministry Role
Company: Christian Broadcasting Network (CBN) - The 700 Club Prayer Center
Industry: Nonprofit Ministry | Faith-Based Contact Center
What Your Day Will Look Like:
This role is genuinely different from a typical call center job, you're praying with callers, not just troubleshooting an issue. CBN operates The 700 Club's prayer line, and your job is connecting with people who call in, ministering to them through prayer, sharing information about CBN's mission, and encouraging financial support for the ministry. This is real, hands-on faith work built into a customer service structure.

You'll need genuine comfort praying aloud with strangers using Scripture-based prayer, while also following structured contact center processes like any other call center role, documentation, meeting performance metrics, and working from scripts when needed while still sounding authentic and warm. This isn't a role where faith is incidental, it's central to what you're doing every single call.

Hours run early, 6:00 AM-12:00 AM EST (5:00 AM-11:00 PM CST) for the overall operation, with weekend and holiday work required as part of the ministry's around-the-clock availability.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not specified in posting.
 Required Experience: 1+ years of experience as a contact center agent or similar customer service work.
 Preferred Experience: Bilingual (English/Spanish) candidates are also being hired for a separate position.
 Required Skills:
Genuine knowledge of the Bible and ability to pray concise, Scripture-based prayers aloud with callers
Strong listening skills with ability to verbally empathize
Fluent, professional English communication, both verbal and written
Ability to sound genuine while reading from a script
Strong computer skills (Windows, web browser, meeting tools, email)
Ability to work weekends and holidays as required
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone with genuine Christian faith and comfort praying with strangers as a core, daily part of their job
Participants with prior contact center or customer service experience who also share CBN's mission and values
Anyone comfortable with early morning hours and required weekend/holiday availability
People who already have qualifying hardwired internet (minimum 50 Mbps, no satellite, wireless, or DSL)
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone who isn't genuinely comfortable or willing to pray aloud with callers as a required, ongoing part of the job, this isn't optional or occasional
Participants who need a fixed daytime-only schedule without weekend or holiday work
Someone without a hardwired high-speed internet connection already in place
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Contact center
Customer service
Ministry/faith-based communication
Prayer support
Scripture knowledge
Empathetic listening
Script delivery
Confidentiality
Remote customer service
Bilingual (if applicable)
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you.
If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen.
If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview.
 Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell me about your comfort level praying aloud with someone you've never met, in a Scripture-based way.
Describe your experience in a contact center or customer service role.
How do you stay genuine and warm while following a required script?
How do you handle maintaining confidentiality with sensitive information shared by callers?
What draws you specifically to CBN's mission, and how does your own faith align with that?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
 
Pay: $15.00/hr for English-language representatives.
Shift: Full-time (40 hrs/week) or part-time (20-25 hrs/week) available. Contact center operates 6:00 AM-12:00 AM EST (5:00 AM-11:00 PM CST). Weekend and holiday work required.
Benefits: Full-time: full benefits package including healthcare, plus a 75% tuition discount at Regent University upon hire. Part-time: vacation leave, sick leave, and 401(k) participation.
Equipment Provided: Yes, CBN provides computer equipment; employee must have their own qualifying hardwired internet router.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated in posting or found in outside research. As a faith-based ministry, CBN may have its own mission-alignment expectations as part of hiring, separate from any criminal background policy. Confirm directly.
Drug Test: Not stated in posting.

Notes: This is a genuine faith-based ministry role, not a standard customer service job with religious branding layered on top. Only refer participants who authentically share CBN's evangelical Christian mission and are comfortable praying with callers as a core, required daily function, this isn't a fit to push someone into just for the pay or schedule if that piece isn't a genuine match. Media Bias/Fact Check rates CBN's flagship program as promoting a right-leaning perspective with mixed factual reporting on some content (separate from the prayer center role itself), worth being aware of as general company context. The 75% Regent University tuition discount for full-time employees is a genuine, notable perk worth highlighting for someone interested in further education.
Career Pathway: Contact Center Representative → Senior Contact Center Representative → Team Lead → Contact Center Supervisor → Contact Center Operations Manager
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
